title: Kwinjira mu igerageza
subtitle: Hitamo umukozi w'igerageza n'ivuriro ukoreramo uyu munsi.
demoOnlyNotice: Igerageza gusa — si ukwinjira mu buryo bwemewe. Guhitamo umukozi ntibyemeza uwo uri we; byerekana gusa icyo urwo ruhare rushobora gukora ku makuru atari ay'ukuri.
noSessionNote: Nta mukozi w'igerageza wahiswemo · Guhindura uruhare ni igerageza gusa — si ukwinjira mu buryo bwemewe
facilityHint: Hagaragazwa gusa amavuriro uyu mukozi yemerewe gukoreramo.
